elements.description: A metric card with a multi-line chart, a legend and a hover tooltip.

properties.name: delta
properties.description: Change against the previous period – positive is green, negative red

properties.name: labels
properties.description: Short labels along the x-axis, e.g. "Mar 4"

properties.name: tooltipLabels
properties.description: Longer labels for the tooltip header, e.g. "Tue, Mar 4" – falls back to `labels`

properties.name: format
properties.description: Formats the axis, tooltip and delta values

properties.name: legend
properties.description: A legend naming each line – unset shows it when there are two or more lines; legend="false" hides it

properties.name: defaultIndex
properties.description: Point that stays highlighted while nobody hovers – unset hides the tooltip at rest

properties.name: index
properties.description: The highlighted point, or null for none (then `defaultIndex` shows)

properties.name: fill
properties.description: Fill the container: no max-width, the card stretches and the plot grows with its height

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-index-change
events.description: The highlighted point changes by pointer or keyboard; detail `{ index: number | null }`. Cancelable: prevent it to control `index`

props.name: defaultIndex
props.description: Point that stays highlighted while nobody hovers – leave empty to hide the tooltip at rest

props.name: index
props.description: The highlighted point (controlled), or null for none

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Called with the point under the pointer or keyboard, or null when it leaves

changelog: kpi-chart `fill`, inline-diff `fill`, usage-meter `layout="wide"` – what screens used to force by overriding internals.
